steps.action: 1. Launch the URL https://e1euut.aws.baxter.com/jde/E1Menu.maf in the browser.
steps.expected: The JD Edwards SSO login page is displayed.

steps.action: 2. Enter the SSO Username in the username field.
steps.expected: The SSO username is entered in the username field.

steps.action: 3. Click the Next button.
steps.expected: The page advances to the password entry step.

steps.action: 4. Enter the SSO Password in the password field.
steps.expected: The SSO password is entered in the password field.

steps.action: 5. Click the Sign in button.
steps.expected: Authentication is initiated and the MFA or confirmation prompt is displayed.

steps.action: 6. Click the Yes button on the Stay signed in prompt.
steps.expected: The JD Edwards home screen (E1Menu) is displayed.

steps.action: 7. Wait for 10 seconds for the JD Edwards home page to fully load.
steps.expected: The JD Edwards home page is fully loaded with the Navigator menu visible.

steps.action: 8. Click the Navigator menu item (el-23).
steps.expected: The Navigator panel expands showing available menu groups including Baxter GM View.

steps.action: 9. Click on Baxter GM View (el-60).
steps.expected: The Baxter GM View menu group expands showing sub-menus including Sales.

steps.action: 10. Click on Sales (el-173).
steps.expected: The Sales sub-menu expands showing options including Sales Order Entry.

steps.action: 11. Click on Sales Order Entry (el-341).
steps.expected: The Sales Order Entry sub-menu expands showing order type options including Standard Order SO.

steps.action: 12. Wait for 5 seconds for the Sales Order Entry menu to fully render.
steps.expected: The Sales Order Entry options are fully visible.

steps.action: 13. Click on Standard Order SO (el-552).
steps.expected: The Standard Order SO - Customer Service Inquiry screen is displayed.

steps.action: 14. Click the Add button (ifr-e1menuAppIframe-el-35) on the Customer Service Inquiry screen.
steps.expected: The Standard Order SO - Sales Order Header form opens for new order entry.

steps.action: 15. Wait for 2 seconds for the Sales Order Header form to load.
steps.expected: The Sales Order Header form is fully loaded with all input fields visible.

steps.action: 16. Click the Sold To field (Long Address Number, ifr-e1menuAppIframe-el-71) on the Sales Order Header form.
steps.expected: The Sold To (Long Address Number) field is focused and ready for input.

steps.action: 17. Enter the Sold To value in the Sold To (Long Address Number) field (ifr-e1menuAppIframe-el-71).
steps.expected: The Sold To value is entered in the field.

steps.action: 18. Press Tab to trigger field validation on the Sold To field.
steps.expected: The system validates the Sold To value and may auto-populate related fields such as customer name.

steps.action: 19. Wait for 5 seconds for the Sold To field validation to complete.
steps.expected: The Sold To field validation is complete and related fields are populated.

steps.action: 20. Click the Ship To field (Long Address Number-Shipto, ifr-e1menuAppIframe-el-72) on the Sales Order Header form.
steps.expected: The Ship To (Long Address Number-Shipto) field is focused and ready for input.

steps.action: 21. Enter the Ship To value in the Ship To (Long Address Number-Shipto) field (ifr-e1menuAppIframe-el-72).
steps.expected: The Ship To value is entered in the field.

steps.action: 22. Press Tab to trigger field validation on the Ship To field.
steps.expected: The system validates the Ship To value and may auto-populate related address fields.

steps.action: 23. Enter the Customer PO value in the Customer PO field (ifr-e1menuAppIframe-el-74).

steps.action: 24. Wait for 5 seconds for the Customer PO field entry to be processed.

steps.action: 25. Click the OK button (ifr-e1menuAppIframe-el-26) on the Sales Order Header form.

steps.action: 26. Wait for 5 seconds for the system to process the Sales Order Header submission.
steps.expected: The system processes the header and may display a confirmation or proceed to the detail entry screen.

steps.action: 27. Click the OK button again (ifr-e1menuAppIframe-el-26) if a second confirmation dialog is presented.

steps.action: 28. Wait for 5 seconds for the Sales Order detail screen to load.
